lyrics: The writer's prose,   the poet's line
Fed into the great machine   to shine
And spit back out, a   hollow clone
A thousand pages, overnight,   alone.
The coder's logic,   clean and tight
Outsourced now to   ones and light.
The legal clerk's   careful search
Done by the box, left   in the lurch.
The artist's hand we just saw fall
Now the engine comes for   all.
It's the digital dustbowl The   long dry wind
Blowin' out the work Of the   human mind.
The fertile soil Is   turned to sand By the algorithm's
cold, invisible   hand.
The trucker's road, the   driver's cab
A self-run program on a data slab.
The teacher's lesson,   planned and learned
Now a "learning module,"   pre-returned.
The customer service, kind   and slow
Replaced by a voice that you'll   never know.
The anchor's smile, the   trusted face
A deepfaked ghost, left   without a trace.
The banker's loan, the trader's bet
Calculated now, no fear,   no sweat.
It's the digital dustbowl The long   dry wind
Blowin' out the work Of the   human mind.
The fertile soil Is turned   to sand By the algorithm's
cold, invisible   hand.
It's not one   field, it's not one town
It's the whole damn harvest, comin'   down.
A new drought made of speed   and code
Lightening everyone's productive load.
And the only crop that's left to grow
Is the one that makes the stock price   go.
And the rest of us... just learn to blow...   away.
The translator's nuance, lost   and flat
The musician's soul, an algorithm's   stat.
The doctor's scan, the diagnosis   read
By the same cold logic, filled   with dread.
Every single thing we learned   to do
Is just more data to be   fed through.
A one-way road with no   way back
A billion lives, all cut   to black.
It's the digital dustbowl The long   dry wind
Blowin' out the work Of the human   mind.
The fertile soil Is   turned to sand By the algorithm's
cold, invisible   hand.
The           algorithm
hums.
The algorithm   hums.
The           algorithm
hums.
The algorithm   hums.
